g1.label: 1. The fans ______ a better performance after three losses.
g1.why: To demand is to ask for something strongly; the fans want a better performance.

g2.label: 2. In Canada, many children play ______ with a stick that has a small net.
g2.why: Lacrosse is the team sport played with a stick that has a small net.

g3.label: 3. Ten teams ______ for the national title every year.
g3.why: Teams compete when they try to beat each other, here for the national title.

g4.label: 4. Despite the loss, the team's ______ was great: everyone sang together on the bus.
g4.why: Team spirit is the strong feeling of unity in a group, shown by singing together.

g5.label: 5. Everyone should ______ in the discussion today.
g5.why: To participate in something is to take part in it.

g6.label: 6. ______, that was an amazing goal! I cannot believe it!
g6.why: 'Man' is an exclamation showing surprise, here at an amazing goal.

g7.label: 7. My job as a nurse is very ______: I work long hours and have little time to rest.
g7.why: A demanding job needs a lot of effort and energy, so there is little time to rest.

g8.label: 8. Sorry, I was in a bad ______ yesterday. I did not mean to shout.
g8.why: Your mood is how you feel at a given time; a bad mood explains shouting.

g9.label: 9. In basketball, you must ______ the ball to a team-mate before you can shoot.
g9.why: To pass the ball is to give it to a team-mate.

g10.label: 10. The match has three ______ of twenty minutes each.
g10.why: A match is divided into equal parts called periods, as in ice hockey.

g11.label: 11. You need a lot of ______ to get up at six and train every day.
g11.why: Discipline is control over yourself; it helps you get up early and train every day.

g12.label: 12. She was tired of losing, so she decided to ______ the team and never come back.
g12.why: To quit is to stop and leave for good; 'never come back' shows she left the team.

g13.label: 13. He was ______ to speak in front of the class, so he stayed quiet.
g13.why: Reluctant means not wanting to do something; he stayed quiet instead of speaking.

g14.label: 14. Berlin in summer is ______: long evenings, open-air concerts and full parks.
g14.why: 'At its best' means as good as it can be, which fits a lovely summer in Berlin.

g15.label: 15. The ______ told the players to run faster in the second half.
g15.why: A coach is the person who trains a team and tells the players what to do.

g16.label: 16. She stayed in and read a book ______ going to the party, because she wanted a quiet evening.
g16.why: 'Instead of' means in place of; she chose a book rather than the party.

g17.label: 17. She was ______ to win the race, so she trained every morning before school.
g17.why: Determined means having decided to succeed, so she trained every morning.

g18.label: 18. She is a very ______ player. She never misses practice and always gives 100%.
g18.why: A committed player gives a lot of time and effort, so she never misses practice.

g19.label: 19. He lost his ______ after five defeats and stopped going to practice.
g19.why: Motivation is the reason you want to do something; after defeats he lost it.

g20.label: 20. The referee gave a ______ because the player pushed an opponent.
g20.why: A penalty is the punishment a referee gives when a player breaks a rule.

g21.label: 21. Playing professional sport takes a lot of time and ______.
g21.why: Commitment is giving your time and effort to something, which professional sport needs.

g22.label: 22. You can borrow my phone ______ you give it back tomorrow.
g22.why: 'As long as' means 'only if', so she must give the phone back to borrow it.

g23.label: 23. Tonight there is a ______ broadcast of the match, so you can watch it as it happens.
g23.why: A live broadcast is shown as it happens, not recorded earlier.

g24.label: 24. My morning ______ is hard: push-ups, sit-ups and a long run. I am tired after it.
g24.why: A workout is a session of hard exercise, such as push-ups and a long run.

g25.label: 25. Small children are ______: they cannot look after themselves.
g25.why: Dependent means needing others for help; small children cannot look after themselves.

g26.label: 26. The teacher wanted to ______ all the students in the project, so everyone had a job.
g26.why: To involve people is to make them part of an activity, so everyone had a job.

g27.label: 27. That was a great lesson. ______, did you hear that the test is on Friday?
g27.why: 'By the way' adds something you just thought of, such as the test on Friday.

g28.label: 28. The young man jumped over walls and ran along roofs in a ______ video.
g28.why: Parkour is the sport of running, jumping and climbing over walls and roofs.

g29.label: 29. You can always ______ him. He never breaks a promise.
g29.why: To rely on someone is to trust that they will help, because he keeps his promises.

g30.label: 30. I always ______ my local team and go to every home match.
g30.why: To support a team is to cheer for it, for example at every home match.

g31.label: 31. I am ______ the rain. It has rained every day for two weeks!
g31.why: To be sick of something is to be tired of it; it rained for two weeks.

g32.label: 32. I am ______ my homework, so I can go out now.
g32.why: To be done with something is to have finished it, so she can go out.

g33.label: 33. The team's 4–1 ______ over Sweden put them top of the table.
g33.why: A win is a victory; 4–1 means the team won the match.

g34.label: 34. Our team ______ in the gym three times a week to get fitter.
g34.why: To train is to practise regularly to get better and fitter.
